title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented FGCU traditions spanning the first day of classes, campus programming, school-spirit gestures, student work, and recurring outdoor gatherings.

cards.title: Begin the Year at Eagle Revolution
cards.subtitle: FGCU’s first-day pep rally inside Alico Arena
cards.notes: Enter Alico Arena ready for a DJ, cheerleaders, E’Gals, Azul, student-athletes, coaches, and a full-arena welcome to the year.
cards.short_summary: FGCU opens each fall with an arena-sized welcome that places new Eagles at the site of their future commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU’s president describes Eagle Revolution as a pep rally held each fall on the first day of school at Alico Arena, featuring a DJ, cheerleaders, E’Gals, Azul, student-athletes, coaches, faculty, staff, and campus leaders.
cards.access_notes: Held on the first day of the fall term; verify the current start time and entry instructions in FGCU announcements.

cards.title: Catch the Annual EagleFest Concert
cards.subtitle: Programming Board’s large-scale fall concert
cards.notes: Watch Programming Board’s official announcement before choosing a date; the annual concert is planned for early fall at Alico Arena.
cards.short_summary: A student-programmed concert brings a major live act to Alico Arena as the academic year gets underway.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU’s Programming Board identifies EagleFest as a large-scale concert held each year and says the current concert is planned for early fall at Alico Arena.
cards.access_notes: The university directs students to Programming Board’s official channels for the artist, date, and ticket announcement.

cards.title: Trade Florida Heat for Winter Wonderland
cards.subtitle: A Programming Board traditions event
cards.notes: Check EagleLink for the current setup and location, then look for the event’s winter-themed installations and student activities.
cards.short_summary: Programming Board gives the Gulf Coast campus a named seasonal celebration through Winter Wonderland.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU lists Winter Wonderland among the spirit and tradition events planned by the Programming Board Traditions Committee.
cards.access_notes: No current date, location, price, or admission terms are stated on the cited page; consult EagleLink before attending.

cards.title: Join Rally at the ROC
cards.subtitle: FGCU spirit programming centered on the ROC
cards.notes: Use EagleLink to confirm the year’s format and meeting point before heading to this named Programming Board traditions event.
cards.short_summary: The recreation-centered Rally at the ROC is part of FGCU’s official student spirit calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU names Rally at the ROC as one of the events developed by the Programming Board Traditions Committee for student spirit and tradition.
cards.access_notes: The cited page does not publish a current schedule or admission policy; verify both through EagleLink.

cards.title: Circle the Globe with Eagles Around the World
cards.subtitle: A globally themed FGCU traditions event
cards.notes: Find the current EagleLink listing, then use the event’s displays and activities to explore how FGCU stages its global theme.
cards.short_summary: Eagles Around the World turns international themes into one of Programming Board’s named campus traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU lists Eagles Around the World among the spirit and tradition events organized by its Programming Board Traditions Committee.
cards.access_notes: Current timing, location, activities, and admission terms are not provided on the cited page; check EagleLink.

cards.title: Pause Between Classes at Live on the Lawn
cards.subtitle: A monthly Library or Cohen Student Union lawn gathering
cards.notes: Look for one Wednesday each month and confirm which lawn is hosting before stopping for music, novelties, and programmed activities.
cards.short_summary: A monthly outdoor pause brings Programming Board activities to one of FGCU’s central lawns.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU describes Live on the Lawn as a monthly program held one Wednesday each month on the Library or Cohen Student Union lawns, with food, novelties, music, and activities.
cards.access_notes: The location alternates between the Library and Cohen Student Union lawns; verify the month’s date and site in EagleLink.

cards.title: Watch Movies on the Library Lawn
cards.subtitle: FGCU’s monthly inflatable-screen movie night
cards.notes: Bring an outdoor layer or blanket after checking the current film and weather plan for the monthly Library Lawn screening.
cards.short_summary: Recent movies move outdoors each month on a large inflatable screen, with movie-style refreshments alongside.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says Movies on the Lawn is a monthly program showing recent films on a large inflatable screen on the Library Lawn, with popcorn or other movie-style refreshments.
cards.access_notes: Film titles, dates, weather arrangements, and admission terms vary; consult the current EagleLink listing.

cards.title: See Student Work Take Over Eagle X
cards.subtitle: FGCU’s annual showcase of student excellence
cards.notes: Walk the displays to compare research, community engagement, internship, and leadership projects from across campus.
cards.short_summary: FGCU gathers standout student projects into one annual showcase spanning four forms of experiential learning.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU calls Eagle X a tradition and its largest annual showcase, featuring student projects in research, community engagement, internships, and leadership; the event is always free and open to the community.
cards.access_notes: The next event is listed for April 23, 2027; the university says Eagle X is always free and open to the community.

cards.title: Put Your Wings Up
cards.subtitle: FGCU’s eagle-inspired hand salute
cards.notes: Join a group photo by raising the documented Wings Up salute, a recurring visual gesture seen at FGCU gatherings and games.
cards.short_summary: Students, employees, families, and Azul turn an eagle-wing hand gesture into a recognizable FGCU photo ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: An official FGCU event story repeatedly identifies employees, families, and attendees giving the Wings Up or wing up salute in photographs at a men’s basketball appreciation night.
cards.access_notes: This is a school-spirit gesture rather than a scheduled attraction; participate where event organizers invite group photos.

cards.entity_name: Cohen Student Union Clock Tower Fight Song
cards.title: Hear the Fight Song from the Clock Tower
cards.subtitle: School spirit broadcast outside Cohen Student Union
cards.notes: Pause outside Cohen Student Union when the music begins and listen for FGCU’s fight song coming from the clock tower.
cards.short_summary: The Cohen Student Union clock tower turns an ordinary campus walk into a brief FGCU fight-song moment.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU’s school-spirit feature states that the song heard outside Cohen Student Union is the university fight song playing from the clock tower.
